scope: Identical native PFET and unmodified PDK under continuous analytic controlled voltage sources. This is a model-isolation diagnostic, not an ADC phase generator or native fanout simulation.
common_requirements: Validate real tool/PDK/geometry provenance and original source hashes; distinguish run completion, observed warning and convergence.
Compare baseline and strict only for identical case/source/electronics and same actual method; require actual 10x voltage/current/reltol tightening and at least 2x smaller maxstep.
Retain every accepted time, initial state, switching edge, all four cycles and both mode directions. No phase alignment or excluded edge when evaluating baseline/strict error.

Evaluate forced source nodes against the exact analytic waveform separately from internal-body and device-current differences. Forced voltage agreement does not validate native phase timing or load interactions.
Report all mode transitions and external signed D-S independently of folded PFET OP vds. Missing internal traces or enums block the corresponding claim.
A warning-free model-isolation run or conserved total terminal current cannot establish model physical accuracy, prove absence of bug, or grant any ADC qualification.

matched.can_establish: Whether the actual native-device/body-network event can occur under local finite slopes and crossing bias without the full ADC/phase feedback or AMS interfaces.
matched.cannot_establish: Whether the isolated waveform reproduces original charge history, original native fanout, physical accuracy of the model or full ADC numerical error.
matched.if_not_reproduced: The local slope/bias reduction is insufficient; no conclusion that the original issue is absent or harmless. Preserve exact full probe as primary reproduction.

static_gate.can_establish: Whether drain crossing alone is sufficient under this controlled fixed gate bias, and how removing dynamic gate drive changes observed body currents.
static_gate.cannot_establish: A unique gate-charge root cause from disappearance alone, because fixed gate also changes initial and preceding stored-charge history.

slow_10x.can_establish: Rate sensitivity when waveform amplitude/bias/relative phase are fixed and all input time scales are enlarged by10.
slow_10x.cannot_establish: A numerical cure for the actual ADC or permission to slow its specified acquisition/conversion timing.
slow_10x.comparison_domain: Baseline/strict remains an absolute-time comparison within each case. Cross-case rate trends may be evaluated at analytically predefined stimulus phase t/T only, explicitly as physical-rate sensitivity, never as waveform-accuracy PASS or fitted time alignment.

finite_1ohm.can_establish: Sensitivity to releasing ideal external D/G voltage clamps through finite controlled source impedance; read actual terminal D/G as well as source DSRC/GSRC.
finite_1ohm.cannot_establish: That1ohm equals native inverter impedance, that the original device error is fixed, or that adding this resistor in ADC is justified. Actual crossing and bias shift from the ideal case.

strict_traponly.can_establish: Method sensitivity at otherwise identical strict settings, including retained body/current overshoot and step-to-step ringing.
strict_traponly.cannot_establish: Same-method numerical convergence by comparing strict gear2only and strict traponly, or superiority based solely on fewer warnings.

repair_decision_boundary: A model-source/drain boundary suspicion requires a reproducible same-device effect plus independently tighter behavior or a supported model/simulator explanation; simultaneous reversed change alone is not proof of a defect.

A numerical-method repair requires a same-method complete ADC baseline/strict pair through reset-abort and the original full-domain0.05LSB requirement; isolated current/body convergence cannot substitute.

A physical phase-buffer change must be a separate native version with real PDK devices and preserved ADC timing/handshake intent. Its effective impedance, kickback and actual sampling waveform must be measured, not assumed from the diagnostic's imposed sources.
No PDK patch, arbitrary body-network disable, added leakage/initial condition/cmin, edge deletion, threshold weakening or ideal ADC replacement.
